topic: Plugins: give Claude Cowork a whole new skill set in one click
post:
Last week you taught Claude one task with a Skill. 🧩
This week: install a whole bundle of them at once, with a Plugin.

A plugin is a package that extends what Claude can do in Cowork. Installing one can add several things in a single step:

🧠 Skills: reusable instructions for a workflow
🔌 Connectors: access to an outside app or service
🤖 Agents: specialist helpers Claude can hand work to

How to install one 👇
1️⃣ Open Customize in the sidebar
2️⃣ Select Plugins, then Discover
3️⃣ Pick a plugin and click Install
4️⃣ Open it to see exactly what it added

Two things beginners miss 👀
✅ Installing doesn't sign you in to anything. If a plugin includes connectors, you connect each one yourself, on its Connectors tab.
✅ You can turn it off any time with "Disable plugin".

Bonus: a plugin you install is saved to your account, so its skills and connectors also work in chat and in Claude Code.

📌 Cowork needs a paid Claude plan (Pro, Max, Team or Enterprise).

Why it matters:
Instead of building every workflow from scratch, you can start from a ready-made toolkit and adjust it. 💡

What kind of plugin would help your job most? 👇

Follow me: I'm teaching one Claude skill a day, no tech background needed.
